subject: Shadow Temple
text: A hidden small chest containing arrows appears in the zombie room when viewed using the Lens of Truth.

evidence.quote: Eliminate the two zombies in this room and then equip the Lens of Truth to see a hidden small chest containing ARROWS.

subject: Shadow Temple
text: Defeating both mummies allows opening a small chest containing a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote: Open the small chest here and collect the BLUE RUPEE from inside after you kill both of the mummies.

subject: Shadow Temple
text: Blowing up the lump near the door reveals a small chest visible with the Lens of Truth that contains a Small Key.

evidence.quote: After doing this equip your bombs and blow up that weird lump near the door. When you do so, equip the Lens of Truth and you'll see a small chest containing a SMALL KEY.

subject: Shadow Temple
text: Playing the Scarecrow's Song allows Link to Longshot across to a platform holding Gold Skulltula 083.

evidence.quote: When you reach the top take out your Ocarina and play the Scarecrow's Song. One will appear on the platform across from you, use the Longshot to grab hold of him and swing over to another GOLD SKULLTULA [083].

subject: Shadow Temple
text: Throwing bombs into the three spinning skulls destroys them and reveals Gold Skulltula 084 on the wall.

evidence.quote: Throw three of them into the three spinning skulls and they will explode into quite a few Rupees. After collecting them check the wall for another GOLD SKULLTULA [084].

subject: Shadow Temple
text: Defeating the invisible Floormaster in the south room makes a small chest appear containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote: You'll need to equip the Lens of Truth once again because there is an invisible Floormaster enemy in this room. Once defeated a small chest will appear containing SMALL KEY.

subject: Shadow Temple
text: A small chest in the spiked wall room contains a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote: Open up the small chest to acquire a BLUE RUPEE, then open up the large coloured chest to get the BOSS KEY.

subject: Shadow Temple
text: A large colored chest in the spiked wall room contains the Boss Key.

evidence.quote: Open up the small chest to acquire a BLUE RUPEE, then open up the large coloured chest to get the BOSS KEY.

subject: Bongo Bongo
text: Each attack from Bongo Bongo deals at least 2 hearts of damage.

evidence.quote: Each one of this attacks deals at least two hearts worth of damage, possibly more.

subject: Bongo Bongo
text: Shooting one of Bongo Bongo's hands turns it blue and causes it to drop an arrow or a magic bottle.

evidence.quote: When you hit one hand it will turn blue and drop an item, either an arrow or a magic bottle, both of which you will be needing for this battle.

subject: Bongo Bongo
text: Stunning both hands, revealing the eye with the Lens of Truth, and shooting it allows defeating Bongo Bongo in two sets of Biggoron's Sword swings.

evidence.quote: The thing about this boss is that using the Biggoron's Sword, you only have to do this twice, the boss will die on the second set of sword swings, so this is why I say offensive is so good.

subject: Bongo Bongo
text: Defeating Bongo Bongo leaves a Heart Container on the ground.

evidence.quote: Collect the HEART CONTAINER from the ground and step into the warp portal.

subject: Link
text: Stepping into the warp portal after the temple takes Link to the sages and awards the Shadow Medallion.

evidence.quote: This will take you to the sages and net you the SHADOW MEDALLION.

subject: Gerudo Valley
text: Gold Skulltula 085 is found at night behind the big stone arch opposite the carpenter.

evidence.quote: Play the Sun's Song so that it becomes night time and then look behind the big stone arch opposite the carpenter to find GOLD SKULLTULA [085].

subject: Gerudo Valley
text: Breaking all rocks near the carpenter using the Megaton Hammer reveals a Purple Rupee.

evidence.quote: After doing that break all the nearby rocks using the Megaton Hammer and you'll find a PURPLE RUPEE.

subject: Gerudo Valley
text: Gold Skulltula 086 is found behind the tent at night.

evidence.quote: Check behind the tent at night and there you will find GOLD SKULLTULA [086].

subject: Gerudo's Fortress
text: Breaking a wooden crate on the roof outside reveals a Purple Rupee.

evidence.quote: Break the wooden crate here and inside you'll find a PURPLE RUPEE.

subject: Gerudo's Fortress
text: A large treasure chest reached by firing the Longshot over the gate contains Piece of Heart 032.

evidence.quote: Inside the large chest is a PIECE OF HEART [032].

subject: Gerudo
text: Defeating the Gerudo woman in the first carpenter's room yields a Small Key to open the jail cell.

evidence.quote: She drops a SMALL KEY when defeated, use it to open the jail cell beside you and free the prisoner.

subject: Gerudo
text: Defeating the Gerudo woman near the second carpenter awards a Small Key to free him.

evidence.quote: Defeat the Gerudo who drops down to get another SMALL KEY and then open the carpenter's cell and speak with him to set him free.

subject: Gerudo's Fortress
text: Gold Skulltula 087 appears on the east wall at night outside near the high single square ledge.

evidence.quote: Play the Sun's Song on your Ocarina to make it night time and when you do, a GOLD SKULLTULA [087] will appear on the wall right beside you. This is on the east wall by the way.

subject: Gerudo
text: Defeating the Gerudo woman by the third jail cell awards a Small Key used to save the third carpenter.

evidence.quote: Down the ramp there third jail cell is found, defeat the Gerudo woman to get a SMALL KEY and then use it to save the third carpenter.

subject: Gerudo
text: Defeating the Gerudo woman by the fourth carpenter's cell awards a Small Key to save him.

evidence.quote: Get the SMALL KEY from the Gerudo and save him.

subject: Gerudo's Fortress
text: Saving all four carpenters triggers a scene granting the Gerudo's Membership Card.

evidence.quote: After this there is a scene and you get the GERUDO'S MEMBERSHIP CARD. Now you can freely move about the fortress without being thrown in jail.

subject: Horseback Archery
text: Hitting a pot awards 100 points, while target centers give 100 points, outer circles give 60 points, and edges give 30 points.

evidence.quote: aim your bow and fire arrows at every single pot you pass, each one of them is worth 100 points... Hitting the centre is worth 100 points, the outer circle is 60 points and the edge is 30 points.

subject: Horseback Archery
text: Accumulating 1000 points at the Horseback Archery game awards Piece of Heart 033.

evidence.quote: Your prize for successfully accumulating 1000 points is a PIECE OF HEART [033].

subject: Horseback Archery
text: Earning 1500 points in Horseback Archery awards the Biggest Quiver, increasing maximum arrow carrying capacity to 50 arrows.

evidence.quote: Your prize for managing to get 1500 points, which is actually quite difficult, is the BIGGEST QUIVER which increases your maximum arrow carrying capacity to 50 arrows.

subject: Horseback Archery
text: Playing one round of Horseback Archery costs twenty Rupees, is only available during the day, and gives twenty arrows.

evidence.quote: The game can only be played during the day, the Gerudo to speak to will not appear at night... The cost to play one round is twenty Rupees... You are given twenty arrows each time you try.
